output.answer_markdown: Comfort Systems USA's market risk exposure in fiscal 2022 was primarily interest rate risk [1]. The company stated it was not exposed to other significant financial market risks, including commodity price risk or foreign currency exchange risk from derivative financial instruments [2]. Its exposure to changes in interest rates ran under its revolving credit facility [3]. Its fixed-rate debt consisted of notes to former owners of acquired companies and acquired notes payable [4], totaling $41,245 thousand at December 31, 2022 [5]. Variable-rate debt totaled $215,000 thousand at that date [6]. The interest rate swaps used to reduce variable rate exposure terminated on September 30, 2022 [7].
